findings.summary: extract_rust calls-edge weight not updated to 1.0
findings.mechanism: confidence was changed to "EXTRACTED" but the accompanying weight literal on the next line was left at 0.8, so Rust call edges now carry an inconsistent EXTRACTED/0.8 pairing while every other language extractor (generic, Go, Zig, PowerShell, Objective-C, Elixir) consistently pairs EXTRACTED with weight 1.0.

findings.summary: "7d" preset was not fixed and still spans 8 days, not 7.
findings.mechanism: The comment and fix apply the correct daysAgo(n-1) adjustment to "30d" and "90d" (daysAgo(29), daysAgo(89)) but leaves "7d" at daysAgo(7) unchanged, so with the inclusive to-today window it still covers 8 calendar days — contradicting the stated task of making "Last 7 days" span exactly 7 days.
